prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Korean virgin ghost, resentful spirit of an unmarried woman.
ANATOMY: ONE pale white-faced young ADULT woman ghost with two sunken eyes and heavy DARK CIRCLES, long loose unbound BLACK HAIR [korean-virgin-ghost-c14,korean-virgin-ghost-c03]. ONE head, TWO arms and TWO legs beneath fully opaque WHITE MOURNING HANBOK [korean-virgin-ghost-c03]. No wounds, blood, fangs, horns or extra anatomy.
MOMENT: Lunge forward out of an abandoned school doorway toward viewer, both pale hands thrust near camera in a furious vengeful reach, body leaning steeply and white hanbok sleeves whipping; mouth open in silent angry cry, dark-ringed eyes stare directly at viewer. No victim shown.
POWER: Haunts in anger and revenge [korean-virgin-ghost-c12], resentment [korean-virgin-ghost-c05]. No visible illness beam or invented curse effect; only ghostly intrusion and anger.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; very tight low doorway framing, pale face and dark eye circles dominate upperhalf and two hands fill foreground; normal human scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant cold moon or amber sunset, deep walnut shadows, strong rim light, physical rain or dust appropriate to scene.
SURFACE: tactile natural skin, coarse opaque cloth, wet hair, wood and stone; premium painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Abandoned dark school building [korean-virgin-ghost-c04].
MOOD: imposing active encounter, never cute, calm or decorative. Preserve benevolent figures as dignified and noble, not evil.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoletters, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no borrowed film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity, blood or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.
depicted_variant: Korean virgin ghost, resentful spirit of an unmarried woman

visual_requirements.description: Pale face with dark circles; omit small blood detail
Angry vengeful haunting, no invented visible curse

aura: Documented anatomy and active encounter create imposing presence, no generic aura.
artistic_choices: Omit c14 small mouth blood to keep no blood/gore. Dynamic reach and extreme close framing create menace without invented anatomy.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: one adult pale face, two dark-ringed eyes, loose black hair, opaque white mourning hanbok, two forward hands with five fingers each. Fierce vengeful doorway lunge in abandoned school c04/c12, no blood, extra anatomy, curse beams or borrowed screen design. Subject confrontational at 200px; all Sangar criteria pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and both-hand, face, torso/skirt and background-interior crops. One pale adult ghost: one head, a white face with heavy dark circles around two dark eyes (korean-virgin-ghost-c14), and long loose wet black hair (c03). Her mouth is open in a furious cry, and the small blood detail of c14 is deliberately omitted per artistic_choices. Fully opaque white mourning hanbok: jeogori with a tied goreum bow and full chima, with no body visible through the cloth (c03). Two hands thrust at the camera, each counted at thumb plus four fingers. She lunges out of a rusted doorway of a rain-soaked, moonlit, abandoned multi-storey building, with dark classroom windows and wooden desks inside (abandoned school, c04). An angry, vengeful confrontation (c05/c12), with no victim, curse beam or invented power. Extreme low angle and foreshortened hands make it clearly terrifying at 200px. The white-hanbok, loose-hair look is the documented Korean iconography (c03), not a copied film design. No text, aura or gore.
